{
  "dataset_name": "volcanoes_c1",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "claude-sonnet-4.6",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "v1_v2_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of V1 to V2, capturing relative magnitude between the two spatial coordinates. Values near 1 indicate symmetry; deviations indicate asymmetry.",
      "value_range": [0.016, 63.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a smooth continuous ratio useful for linear SVM margins to distinguish spatial asymmetry patterns.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "V1 / (V2 + 1e-6)"
    },
    {
      "name": "v1_v2_diff_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Normalized absolute difference between V1 and V2, scaled by their sum. Measures relative divergence between the two coordinates.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth normalized score in [0,1] capturing spatial divergence, well-suited for linear SVM decision boundaries.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.abs(V1 - V2) / (V1 + V2 + 1e-6)"
    },
    {
      "name": "v3_log_scaled",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed V3 value to reduce skewness and compress the range for better linear separability.",
      "value_range": [-15.0, 0.0],
      "feature_family": "transformation",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Log transformation of V3 linearizes its distribution, improving linear SVM margin quality.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(V3) - np.log1p(0.788685)"
    },
    {
      "name": "v1_mean_deviation",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Standardized deviation of V1 from its training mean (509.97), scaled by training std (280.32).",
      "value_range": [-1.77, 1.77],
      "feature_family": "normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Zero-centered normalized feature directly usable as a linear projection component for SVM.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(V1 - 509.9693723069757) / 280.3206803251786"
    },
    {
      "name": "v2_mean_deviation",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Standardized deviation of V2 from its training mean (510.44), scaled by training std (288.58).",
      "value_range": [-1.72, 1.72],
      "feature_family": "normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Zero-centered normalized feature directly usable as a linear projection component for SVM.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(V2 - 510.44392686619307) / 288.5767599415063"
    },
    {
      "name": "v3_mean_deviation",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Standardized deviation of V3 from its training mean (0.4111), scaled by training std (0.0608).",
      "value_range": [-6.76, 6.21],
      "feature_family": "normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Zero-centered normalized V3 feature for linear SVM, capturing how far V3 deviates from typical values.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(V3 - 0.41113052486316526) / 0.06076998440149803"
    },
    {
      "name": "v1_v2_product_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Product of normalized V1 and V2, capturing joint spatial magnitude interaction.",
      "value_range": [-3.14, 3.14],
      "feature_family": "interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Bilinear interaction term approximating a kernel feature, useful for linear SVM to capture joint coordinate effects.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "((V1 - 509.9693723069757) / 280.3206803251786) * ((V2 - 510.44392686619307) / 288.5767599415063)"
    },
    {
      "name": "v3_v1_interaction",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Interaction between normalized V3 and normalized V1, capturing how spatial intensity relates to coordinate position.",
      "value_range": [-11.97, 10.99],
      "feature_family": "interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Cross-feature interaction term that helps linear SVM capture non-linear relationships between V3 intensity and V1 position.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "((V3 - 0.41113052486316526) / 0.06076998440149803) * ((V1 - 509.9693723069757) / 280.3206803251786)"
    },
    {
      "name": "v3_v2_interaction",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Interaction between normalized V3 and normalized V2, capturing how spatial intensity relates to the second coordinate.",
      "value_range": [-11.63, 10.69],
      "feature_family": "interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Cross-feature interaction term that helps linear SVM capture non-linear relationships between V3 intensity and V2 position.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "((V3 - 0.41113052486316526) / 0.06076998440149803) * ((V2 - 510.44392686619307) / 288.5767599415063)"
    },
    {
      "name": "spatial_magnitude",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Euclidean-like combined magnitude of V1 and V2, normalized by the maximum possible value (1008*sqrt(2)).",
      "value_range": [0.011, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth normalized composite score representing overall spatial magnitude, useful as a single linear feature for SVM.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.sqrt(V1**2 + V2**2) / (1008.0 * 1.41422)"
    },
    {
      "name": "v3_intensity_severity",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic severity score for V3 intensity level. V3 near 0 or near its max (0.789) may indicate extreme conditions; values near the mean (0.411) are moderate. Score reflects deviation from the central tendency on a 0-10 scale.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "severity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Interpretable severity score that maps V3 to a human-meaningful scale, providing a smooth continuous input for linear SVM margins.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "spatial_asymmetry_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic asymmetry score combining V1-V2 divergence and V3 intensity. High scores indicate strong spatial asymmetry with extreme V3 values, potentially indicating volcanic features. Scored 0-10.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Weighted composite score capturing multi-feature asymmetry patterns, providing a smooth interpretable input for linear SVM decision boundaries.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
